{{Quote|No, some are very happy with their delusions, so much so that I envy some of them.|Doctor S. Pelbion on his patients|<ref name="o66" />}}
'''S. Pelbion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who served as the deputy chief [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[Valorum Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="o66" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Pelbion gave former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]] a tour of the Valorum Center while the latter was on mission to find doctor [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]].<ref name="o66" />

==Personality and traits==
S. Pelbion had a thin build and appeared to be in his fifties. He had a habit of constantly glancing over his shoulder while passing through security doors in the hospital where he worked, as though expecting an attack from the inmates. He once remarked that he envied some of his patients who were happy with their delusions.<ref name="o66" />
